changelog:
v3.0.0 — Streaming Cinema Experience

• Hero Trailer Auto-Play — movies preview automatically after 4s dwell, full-bleed muted video
• D-pad left/right to browse hero movies
• Parallax hero scroll — backdrop moves at 40% speed for depth effect
• Time-of-Day Aurora — background shifts warm/cool/dark based on time
• Quick Tune Channel Strip — circular channel logos for instant playback, pulls from favorites
• Because You Watched — personalized rows matched by genre & cast overlap
• Live Sports Banner — real-time sports events with EPG data, auto-rotating
• Smart Trending — movies/series ranked by rating, recency & your watch habits
• Enhanced aurora background — more visible atmospheric lighting
• Favorites live TV logos now match Live TV screen style
• EPG base64 cache fix — no more encoded text in sports banner
